title: GrowthBook hero (v2)
description: A centred, regular-weight 68px headline on a near-white page, a short muted line and an outline + violet button pair, over a wide violet-to-mint gradient frame. A dark pill tab group sits on the frame and switches the product shot below it, which the frame's bottom edge crops. Phones stack the buttons full width and run the frame edge to edge.
notes: needs JavaScript for the tabs (hydrate: load)
each tab takes its own media; empty, the shot is a plain card-coloured placeholder
name: growthbook-v2-hero

props.name: title
props.description: the headline; use \n for the line breaks you want on desktop

props.name: subtitle
props.description: one or two sentences under it

props.name: actions
props.type: { label: string; href: string; variant?: "primary" | "outline" | undefined; }[]
props.description: usually two: outline first, then the primary one (gets an arrow)

props.name: tabs
props.description: the pill tabs on the frame; at least one

props.name: backdrop
props.description: a real image or video for the frame's backdrop; empty = the violet gradient
